<!-- nativecmpkit-resolution:NAV-001:20261027-original-acceptance -->
## Verified resolution — original NAV-001 acceptance

**Root cause:** Navigation stored only route strings and dispatched static graph schemas, losing visit-specific payloads.

**Repair:** The controller now stores unique entries with copied portable argument values; destination resolution validates missing/null/type/default values before mutation, dispatches per-entry values and saves/restores IDs and payloads. Unsupported values fail predictably.

**Affected implementation:** [`calf-navigation/src/commonMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/navigation/AdaptiveNavHostController.kt`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/8ab82a3fa41caad34cd7fb7a2d3722bfc25e3838/calf-navigation/src/commonMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/navigation/AdaptiveNavHostController.kt) — navigateWithValues / saveState / restoreState; NavDestination.resolveArguments; AdaptiveNavHost.

### Original required checks reviewed
- **Navigate to one route with two distinct payloads; each visit receives its own values.** — passed-scoped-runtime. Methods: `AdaptiveNavControllerTest.duplicateRoutesAndPayloadsHaveIndependentEntryIdentity`, `AdaptiveNavHostStateTest.entry payloads and defaults reach legacy content callbacks`.
- **Validate missing, nullable, wrong-type and defaulted arguments.** — passed-scoped-runtime. Methods: `AdaptiveNavControllerTest.graphMergesDefaultsAndRejectsMissingWrongTypeNullAndUnknownRoutes`.
- **Round-trip entry IDs and arguments through the saver; reject unsupported values predictably.** — passed-scoped-runtime. Methods: `AdaptiveNavControllerTest.versionedSaverRoundTripsIdentityEveryPortablePayloadAndFurtherPops`, `AdaptiveNavControllerTest.publicSaverUsesTheSameRoundTripAndAcceptsLegacyRouteArray`, `AdaptiveNavControllerTest.unsupportedPayloadsAndSchemaOnlyNavigationArgumentsFailBeforeMutation`.

[Verbatim original-requirement/source/Git/XML review](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/8ab82a3fa41caad34cd7fb7a2d3722bfc25e3838/docs/development/evidence/closure-review-20261027-001/lead-original-acceptance-review.json) at immutable evidence commit `8ab82a3fa41caad34cd7fb7a2d3722bfc25e3838`. Owning navigation source/test/build bytes match `6eb7c66eb01b390353100c63882cd102846c7b8d`: Linux51/51 + Android-host37/37 ([40414284598](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40414284598)); macOS51/51 + iOS39/39 ([40415332643](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40415332643)). These178 target executions reuse51 source methods. The historical Apple run failed elsewhere; only the passed navigation scope is accepted. 

[Current staged preflight](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/8ab82a3fa41caad34cd7fb7a2d3722bfc25e3838/docs/development/evidence/ci-preflight-20261027-019/lead-review.json) passes23/23 commands,1,137 overlapping Python executions, strict documentation/actionlint and both whitespace checks; it executes zero new library/native/packaged methods.

**Compatibility / limits:** Public package/class names and legacy navigate/pop signatures retained; ADR0004 defines corrected behavior and limits. No whole-library ABI certification. Original issue description, labels, upstream discussion and previous remaining notes are preserved. This closes only the original specific defect after required-scope review; minimum-platform/device/native-stack integration, whole-library API/ABI, full packaged consumers, dependency trust, legal/native-payload and all other issue/release gates remain independent and are not waived. No package, release, deployment or Pages publication.
